title: युद्ध में AI के इस्तेमाल पर भारत ने जताई चिंता, UN में आतंकियों के हाथों दुरुपयोग को बताया बड़ा खतरा
description: भारत ने संयुक्त राष्ट्र में कहा कि AI के उपयोग में इंसानी फैसला और निगरानी सबसे महत्वपूर्ण होनी चाहिए. साथ ही ये भी कहा कि टेक्नोलॉजी को मानवीय उद्देश्यों के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए, .
author: जूही उरूषा खान
content:
युद्ध में AI के इस्तेमाल पर भारत ने जताई चिंता, UN में आतंकियों के हाथों दुरुपयोग को बताया बड़ा खतरा
भारत ने संयुक्त राष्ट्र में कहा कि AI के उपयोग में इंसानी फैसला और निगरानी सबसे महत्वपूर्ण होनी चाहिए. साथ ही ये भी कहा कि टेक्नोलॉजी को मानवीय उद्देश्यों के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए, .
भारत ने युद्ध और संघर्ष की स्थिती में आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस (AI) और दूसरी उभरती टेक्नोलॉजी के इस्तेमाल को लेकर संयुक्त राष्ट्र (UN) में अपना रुख स्पष्ट किया है. भारत ने AI के गलत इस्तेमाल पर चिंता जताई है और इसके खतरे को लेकर आगाह किया. भारत ने युद्ध की स्थितियों में नई टेक्नोलॉजी, खासकर AI के इस्तेमाल के लिए इंसानी सोच वाला और जिम्मेदार तरीका अपनाने की अपील की है. इसके साथ ही इस बात पर जोर दिया कि इंसानी फैसले और निगरानी इन टेक्नोलॉजी के इस्तेमाल में सबसे महत्वपूर्ण होनी चाहिए.
मंगलवार को लातविया द्वारा बुलाई गई UN सिक्योरिटी काउंसिल की हाई-लेवल ओपन डिबेट में भारत का पक्ष रखते हुए, यूनाइटेड नेशंस में भारत के परमानेंट रिप्रेजेंटेटिव, एम्बेसडर हरीश पर्वतनेनी ने कहा कि तेज़ी से हो रही टेक्नोलॉजी की तरक्की युद्ध के तरीके और इंटरनेशनल सिक्योरिटी के माहौल को पूरी तरह से बदल रही है.
पर्वतनेनी ने चार खास बातें बताईं
‘तेज़ी से बदलते टेक्नोलॉजिकल बदलाव के दौर में टकराव का हल’ (Conflict Resolution in an Era of Rapid Technological Change) थीम पर बोलते हुए, पर्वतनेनी ने चार खास बातें बताईं, जिनसे टकराव की स्थितियों में नई टेक्नोलॉजी की बढ़ती भूमिका पर इंटरनेशनल कम्युनिटी को अपनी प्रतिक्रिया देनी चाहिए.
‘टेक्नोलॉजी की तरक्की से युद्ध में बदलाव’
उन्होंने कहा, ‘तेज़ी से हो रही टेक्नोलॉजी की तरक्की लड़ाई के तरीके और इंटरनेशनल सिक्योरिटी के माहौल को पूरी तरह बदल रही है. आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस, ऑटोनॉमस सिस्टम और नई डिजिटल टेक्नोलॉजी पहले कभी नहीं देखे गए मौके देती हैं, लेकिन साथ ही पूरे युद्ध के दौरान नई कमजोरियां और जोखिम भी लाती . मिलिट्री, इंटेलिजेंस और सिविलियन इलाकों में आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस के तेज़ी से जुड़ने से इंटरनेशनल शांति और सिक्योरिटी का माहौल पूरी तरह बदल गया है’.
‘टेक्नोलॉजी को इंसान पर केंद्रित रहना चाहिए’
इस बात पर ज़ोर देते हुए कि टेक्नोलॉजी को इंसानी केंद्रित रहना चाहिए और शांति के साधन के तौर पर काम करना चाहिए, भारतीय राजदूत ने कहा कि इसका इस्तेमाल इंसानों से जुड़े मकसद को पाने के लिए किया जाना चाहिए, न कि यह अपने आप में एक मकसद बन जाए. उन्होंने कहा, ‘टेक्नोलॉजी इंसानों के तय मकसद और लक्ष्य पाने का एक तरीका है. यह अपने आप में कोई मकसद नहीं है’.
उन्होंने कहा कि नई टेक्नोलॉजी, लड़ाई-झगड़े की स्थितियों में शुरुआती चेतावनी के तरीकों को मजबूत करके, हालात के बारे में जानकारी बढ़ाकर, बीच-बचाव में मदद करके और शांति अभियानों की सुरक्षा और असर को बढ़ाकर एक अच्छा रोल निभा सकती हैं.
उन्होंने कहा, ‘युद्ध के हालात में, नई टेक्नोलॉजी शुरुआती चेतावनी को मजबूत कर सकती हैं, हालात के बारे में जानकारी बेहतर कर सकती हैं, बीच-बचाव में मदद कर सकती हैं, और शांति अभियानों की सुरक्षा और असर को बढ़ा सकती हैं, साथ ही मौजूदा अंतरराष्ट्रीय मानवीय कानून के सिद्धांतों को बनाए रखने की कोशिशों में मदद कर सकती हैं’. उन्होंने कहा कि AI वाले एनालिटिकल टूल्स, सैटेलाइट इमेजरी और डिजिटल प्लेटफॉर्म यूनाइटेड नेशंस को संकट का अंदाज़ा लगाने और ज़्यादा असरदार तरीके से जवाब देने में मदद कर सकते हैं.
‘टेक्नोलॉजी का इस्तेमाल ज़िम्मेदारी भरा हो’
पर्वतनेनी ने कहा कि दूसरी बात यह पक्का करना है कि युद्ध वाली जगहों पर नई टेक्नोलॉजी का इस्तेमाल ज़िम्मेदारी भरा, इंसानी सोच वाला, सॉवरेनिटी का सम्मान करने वाला और इंटरनेशनल कानून के हिसाब से हो. उन्होंने कहा, ‘सुरक्षा के लिए टेक्नोलॉजी का इस्तेमाल एक क्रॉस-कटिंग और क्रॉस-सेक्टोरल उपाय होना चाहिए’ इसका इस्तेमाल आम लोगों, शांति सैनिकों की सुरक्षा के लिए किया जाना चाहिए और मानवीय मदद करने वाले लोगों की सुरक्षा के लिए भी इसका इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए’.
जानलेवा ऑटोनॉमस वेपन सिस्टम से जुड़ी चिंताओं का ज़िक्र करते हुए उन्होंने कहा कि उनके इस्तेमाल से सही कानूनी और नैतिक सवाल उठते हैं. उन्होंने आगे कहा कि भारत, कन्वेंशन ऑन प्रोहिबिशन्स ऑर रिस्ट्रिक्शन्स ऑन द यूज़ ऑफ़ सर्टेन कन्वेंशनल वेपन्स (CCW) के फ्रेमवर्क के अंदर इन चिंताओं को दूर करने के लिए कमिटेड है, जो मिलिट्री ज़रूरत और मानवीय बातों के बीच बैलेंस बनाने की कोशिश करता है.
उन्होंने कहा, ‘हथियार सिस्टम के ऑपरेशनल संदर्भ और विशेषताओं को ध्यान में रखते हुए, इंसानी फ़ैसला और निगरानी ज़रूरी है. ऐसे सिस्टम के इस्तेमाल की ज़िम्मेदारी हमेशा इंसानों की होनी चाहिए’.
आतंकियों के हाथ में AI से दुनिया को खतरा
तीसरी बात आतंकवादी ग्रुप और नॉन-स्टेट एक्टर द्वारा नई टेक्नोलॉजी, खासकर आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस के गलत इस्तेमाल से पैदा होने वाले खतरों से निपटना था. पर्वतनेनी ने कहा, ‘ AI से जुड़े रिस्क असली हैं, और हमें बिना किसी झिझक के उनसे निपटना चाहिए. आतंकवादियों और नॉन-स्टेट एक्टर्स द्वारा इन नई टेक्नोलॉजी का गलत इस्तेमाल बहुत चिंता की बात है. AI के ज़रिए अधूरा, गलत, या जानबूझकर बदला गया डेटा फैसले लेने की क्षमता को कमजोर कर सकता है’.
‘भारत ने नई टेक्नोलॉजी में काफी तरक्की की है’
डिजिटल इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर और साइबर सिक्योरिटी को मजबूत करने में भारत की कोशिशों पर ज़ोर देते हुए उन्होंने कहा कि देश ने नई टेक्नोलॉजी में काफी तरक्की की है, जिसमें ज़रूरी इन्फॉर्मेशन इंफ्रास्ट्रक्चर की सुरक्षा और ज़रूरी सिविलियन सर्विस की कंटिन्यूटी पक्का करने पर ज़ोर दिया गया है.
उन्होंने कहा, ‘देश में, इन्फॉर्मेशन टेक्नोलॉजी एक्ट और उससे जुड़े नियम बिना इजाज़त के एक्सेस, डेटा से छेड़छाड़ और कंप्यूटर सिस्टम में रुकावट के खिलाफ मजबूत सुरक्षा देते हैं, जो हथियारों वाली लड़ाई के दौरान भी ज़रूरी हैं’.
‘टेक्नोलॉजी में बदलाव से मौजूदा असमानताएं और न बढ़ें’
भारतीय राजदूत के अनुसार, चौथी बात यह पक्का करना था कि टेक्नोलॉजी में बदलाव से मौजूदा असमानताएं और न बढ़ें, खासकर विकसित देशों और ग्लोबल साउथ के देशों के बीच. उन्होंने कहा, ‘हम टेक्नोलॉजी को नकारने और एक्सपोर्ट कंट्रोल और लाइसेंसिंग सिस्टम के ज़रिए स्ट्रेटेजिक एक-दूसरे से आगे निकलने के लिए टेक्नोलॉजी का इस्तेमाल करने के उभरते मीडियम और लॉन्ग-टर्म ट्रेंड्स पर चिंता के साथ ध्यान दे रहे हैं. साथ ही, ग्लोबल साउथ के देशों को सिर्फ़ कंज्यूमर मानने की प्रवृत्ति भी है, जिसमें AI जैसी उभरती टेक्नोलॉजी को कैसे डेवलप किया जाए, रेगुलेट किया जाए और इस्तेमाल किया जाए, इसमें उनकी कोई एजेंसी या हिस्सेदारी नहीं है’.
AI को लेकर दी चेतावनी
उन्होंने यह भी चेतावनी दी कि आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस सिस्टम मौजूदा सामाजिक भेदभाव को बनाए रख सकते हैं और इस बात पर ज़ोर दिया कि टेक्नोलॉजी के विकास से इंसानी इज्ज़त कम नहीं होनी चाहिए. उन्होंने कहा, ‘AI सिस्टम अनजाने में जेंडर, भाषा और सोशियो-इकोनॉमिक बैकग्राउंड से जुड़े भेदभाव को बढ़ावा दे सकते हैं. AI को इंसानों को सिर्फ़ डेटा पॉइंट या रॉ मटेरियल तक सीमित नहीं रखना चाहिए’.
पर्वतनेनी ने कहा कि भारत, नेशनल प्रायोरिटी और डेवलपमेंट की ज़रूरतों को ध्यान में रखते हुए, यूनाइटेड नेशंस के ज़रिए टेक्नोलॉजी गवर्नेंस पर इनक्लूसिव इंटरनेशनल कोऑपरेशन का सपोर्ट करता है. इस संदर्भ में, उन्होंने मल्टीलेटरल सिस्टम, खासकर UN सिक्योरिटी काउंसिल में सुधारों के महत्व पर ज़ोर दिया, जिसमें आज की हकीकत को दिखाने के लिए परमानेंट और नॉन-परमानेंट दोनों कैटेगरी में विस्तार शामिल है.
दिल्ली में आयोजित AI इम्पैक्ट समिट का जिक्र
टेक्नोलॉजिकल इनोवेशन और उससे जुड़े रिस्क को दूर करने की ज़रूरत के बीच बैलेंस बनाने पर भारत की बात दोहराते हुए, पर्वतनेनी ने इस साल फरवरी में नई दिल्ली में भारत द्वारा होस्ट किए गए AI इम्पैक्ट समिट का ज़िक्र किया.
उन्होंने कहा, ‘इस साल फरवरी में, हमें नई दिल्ली में AI इम्पैक्ट समिट होस्ट करने पर गर्व था, यह ग्लोबल साउथ के किसी देश द्वारा बुलाई गई अपनी तरह की पहली मीटिंग थी. समिट में नई दिल्ली डिक्लेरेशन तैयार हुआ, जिसे 90 से ज़्यादा देशों ने सपोर्ट किया, जिसमें AI रिसोर्स तक एक्सेस को डेमोक्रेटाइज़ करने, सुरक्षित और भरोसेमंद सिस्टम बनाने, इंसानी क्षमताओं में इन्वेस्ट करने और आर्थिक विकास और समाज की भलाई के लिए AI का इस्तेमाल करने पर ज़ोर दिया गया’.
अपना बयान खत्म करते हुए, भारतीय राजदूत ने कहा कि टेक्नोलॉजी में तरक्की से आखिर में इंसानियत की सेवा होनी चाहिए, इंटरनेशनल सहयोग मजबूत होना चाहिए और हमेशा रहने वाली शांति में योगदान देना चाहिए.
उन्होंने कहा, ‘आखिर में, मकसद साफ रहना चाहिए. टेक्नोलॉजी को इंसानियत की सेवा करनी चाहिए, इंटरनेशनल सहयोग को मजबूत करना चाहिए, और हमेशा रहने वाली शांति के मकसद को आगे बढ़ाना चाहिए.। टेक्नोलॉजी इंसानी फैसले लेने में मदद कर सकती है लेकिन उसकी जगह नहीं ले सकती या नहीं लेनी चाहिए’.

title: छुट्टी के बाद खुलते ही बाजार में तूफानी तेजी, 1400 अंक उछला सेंसेक्स, निफ्टी ने भी भरी उड़ान!
description: बुधवार को भारतीय शेयर बाजार ने जोरदार तेजी के साथ शुरुआत की. सेंसेक्स 1,426 अंक उछलकर 83,862 के पार गया, वहीं निफ्टी 389 अंक ऊपर खुला. विदेशी निवेशकों की खरीदारी और सस्ते कच्चे तेल ने सहारा दिया.
author: विभव शुक्ला
content:
छुट्टी के बाद खुलते ही बाजार में तूफानी तेजी, 1400 अंक उछला सेंसेक्स, निफ्टी ने भी भरी उड़ान!
बुधवार को भारतीय शेयर बाजार ने जोरदार तेजी के साथ शुरुआत की. सेंसेक्स 1,426 अंक उछलकर 83,862 के पार गया, वहीं निफ्टी 389 अंक ऊपर खुला. विदेशी निवेशकों की खरीदारी और सस्ते कच्चे तेल ने सहारा दिया.
एक दिन की छुट्टी के बाद बुधवार की सुबह भारतीय शेयर बाजार के लिए जबरदस्त रौनक लेकर आई. कारोबार शुरू होते ही दोनों प्रमुख इंडेक्स ने लंबी छलांग लगा दी. बीएसई सेंसेक्स 1,426.44 अंक यानी 1.73 फीसदी की जोरदार बढ़त के साथ 83,862.43 के स्तर पर खुला. इसी तरह एनएसई निफ्टी 50 भी 389.50 अंक यानी 1.54 फीसदी उछलकर 25,739.15 के स्तर पर पहुंच गया. बाजार की इस शानदार वापसी के पीछे दो बड़े कारण रहे. एक तरफ विदेशी निवेशक भारतीय शेयरों में लगातार पैसा लगा रहे हैं, तो दूसरी तरफ कच्चे तेल की कीमतों में आ रही नरमी ने बाजार का मूड बदल दिया.
छुट्टी से पहले लगा था बड़ा झटका
बुधवार की ये तेजी इसलिए भी खास है क्योंकि हफ्ते की शुरुआत बाजार के लिए अच्छी नहीं रही थी. सोमवार को भारतीय बाजार में तेज बिकवाली देखने को मिली थी. चार हफ्ते की लगातार तेजी के बाद निवेशकों ने जमकर मुनाफावसूली की, जिसके चलते प्रमुख इंडेक्स 1.8 फीसदी तक टूट गए थे. इसके बाद मंगलवार को स्थानीय छुट्टी होने की वजह से शेयर बाजार बंद रहा. जब बुधवार को ट्रेडिंग दोबारा शुरू हुई, तो सोमवार की गिरावट को पीछे छोड़ते हुए बाजार ने सीधे ऊपरी स्तर पर शुरुआत की.
AI शेयरों से पैसा निकाल भारत ला रहे विदेशी निवेशक
घरेलू बाजार को सबसे बड़ा सहारा विदेशी निवेशकों से मिल रहा है. उतार-चढ़ाव के बीच भी विदेशी निवेशक भारतीय इक्विटी में लगातार खरीदारी कर रहे हैं. शुरुआती आंकड़ों के मुताबिक, सोमवार को बाजार में गिरावट के दिन भी विदेशी निवेशकों ने 5,673 करोड़ रुपये यानी 610.59 मिलियन डॉलर के शेयर खरीदे.
समाचार एजेंसी रॉयटर्स की रिपोर्ट बताती है कि नवंबर में अब तक विदेशी निवेशक भारतीय शेयर बाजार में रिकॉर्ड 14.28 अरब डॉलर लगा चुके हैं. इस बड़े निवेश की वजह ग्लोबल बाजार में हो रहा बदलाव है. दरअसल, विदेशी निवेशक दुनिया भर के आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस (AI) से जुड़े शेयरों से अपना पैसा निकाल रहे हैं. वही पैसा अब भारतीय शेयर बाजार की तरफ मुड़ रहा है, जिसका सीधा फायदा घरेलू बाजार को मिला है.
कच्चे तेल की गिरावट से बाजार को मिली राहत
विदेशी निवेश के अलावा कच्चे तेल के मोर्चे से आई खबर ने भी बाजार के सेंटिमेंट को मजबूत किया. अंतरराष्ट्रीय बाजार में ब्रेंट क्रूड फ्यूचर्स 0.7 फीसदी गिरकर 90.8 डॉलर प्रति बैरल पर आ गया. कच्चे तेल के दाम घटने के पीछे दो मुख्य वजहें हैं. पहला, बाजार में तेल की सप्लाई लगातार बढ़ रही है. दूसरा, आगे बाजार में जरूरत से ज्यादा तेल यानी सरप्लस रहने की उम्मीद जताई जा रही है.
नवंबर का महीना कच्चे तेल की कीमतों के लिए काफी नरम रहा है. इस महीने अब तक तेल के दाम करीब 23 फीसदी तक नीचे आ चुके हैं. विदेशी निवेशकों के रिकॉर्ड निवेश के साथ कच्चे तेल की इस बड़ी गिरावट ने मिलकर बुधवार को सेंसेक्स के 1,400 अंकों से ज्यादा के उछाल की जमीन तैयार कर दी.

title: VIDEO: वैभव सूर्यवंशी के तूफान का राज, युवराज सिंह का 30 मिनट वाला मंत्र, मैच से पहले इन 4 लोगों से की...
description: वैभव सूर्यवंशी के UAE के खिलाफ की आतिशबाजी का राज खुल गया. इस बारे में भी पता चल गया कि उन्होंने मैच से पहले किन 4 लोगों से बात की थी. वैभव ने खुद से इस बारे में बताया है.
author: साकेत शर्मा
content:
VIDEO: वैभव सूर्यवंशी के तूफान का राज, युवराज सिंह का 30 मिनट वाला मंत्र, मैच से पहले इन 4 लोगों से की थी बात
वैभव सूर्यवंशी के UAE के खिलाफ की आतिशबाजी का राज खुल गया. इस बारे में भी पता चल गया कि उन्होंने मैच से पहले किन 4 लोगों से बात की थी. वैभव ने खुद से इस बारे में बताया है.
वैभव सूर्यवंशी ने तूफान तो पहले भी मचाए हैं. बल्ले के जोर पर गेंदबाजों को पहले भी अपने सामने कांपने पर मजबूर किया है. मगर एशिया कप राइजिंग स्टार्स में 24 नवंबर को UAE के खिलाफ मुकाबले में जो उन्होंने किया, वो कुछ अलग ही था. वैभव का ये तूफान बल्ले से मचाए उनके पिछले सारे तूफानों से अलग था. शायद इसलिए क्योंकि इसके पीछे की वजह थे युवराज सिंह और उनका 30 मिनट वाला मंत्र. वैभव सूर्यवंशी ने खुद इस बारे में बताया है, जिसका वीडियो BCCI ने शेयर किया है. इतना ही नहीं वैभव ने UAE के खिलाफ मैच से पहले जिन 4 लोगों से बात की थी, उनके बारे में भी खुलासा किया.
वैभव ने मैच से पहले किन 4 लोगों से बात की थी?
वैभव सूर्यवंशी ने बताया कि उन्होंने मैच से पहले 4 लोगों से बात की थी. उन्होंने सबसे पहले अपने पिता संजीव सूर्यवंशी को फोन किया था. उन्होंने अपने कोच मनीष ओझा से बात की थी. वैभव ने अपने अंडर 19 के टीममेट प्रथम जांच को फोन मिलाया था. वहीं चौथे शख्स जिससे वैभव ने बात की, वो थे युवराज सिंह.

युवराज सिंह से 30 मिनट तक फोन पर की बात- वैभव सूर्यवंशी
वैभव सूर्यवंशी का अपने पिता, अपने कोच, अपने दोस्त से मैच के पहले बात करना तो महत्वपूर्ण था. मगर सबसे ज्यादा महत्वपूर्ण रहा उनका युवराज सिंह से बात करना. वैभव ने वीडियो में बताया कि उन्होंने युवराज सिंह से 30 मिनट तक फोन कॉल पर बात की थी. उनके मुताबिक इस 30 मिनट में युवराज सिंह ने उन्हें बल्लेबाजी के बारे में बताया. उन्होंने उन्हें बताया कि बल्लेबाजी करनी कैसे है?
वैभव ने बताया कि पहले दो मैचों में बल्ला नहीं चला तो वो थोड़े परेशान हो गए. ऐसे में उन्होंने युवराज सिंह से बात की. उन्हें अपनी समस्याएं बताई. सब सुनने के बाद उन्होंने मुझे कहा कि तुम अगर 20 गेंद खेलते हो तो उसके पहले डिफेंड करो. इसके अलावा उन्होंने बल्लेबाजी के तकनीकी चीजों पर भी बात की, जिसका मुझे UAE के खिलाफ इनिंग में फायदा हुआ.

title: Naagzilla: कार्तिक आर्यन की ‘नागजिला’ में रवि किशन की एंट्री, ‘इच्छाधारी नाग’...
description: Naagzilla: कार्तिक आर्यन की फैंटेसी-कॉमेडी फिल्म 'नागजिला' में रवि किशन की एंट्री हो गई है. जहां वो 'इच्छाधारी नाग' बने कार्तिक के सामने विलेन 'पाइथन' के किरदार में नजर आएंगे.
author: अंकिता चौहान
content:
Naagzilla: कार्तिक आर्यन की ‘नागजिला’ में रवि किशन की एंट्री, ‘इच्छाधारी नाग’ से होगी जबरदस्त टक्कर!
Naagzilla: कार्तिक आर्यन की फैंटेसी-कॉमेडी फिल्म 'नागजिला' में रवि किशन की एंट्री हो गई है. जहां वो 'इच्छाधारी नाग' बने कार्तिक के सामने विलेन 'पाइथन' के किरदार में नजर आएंगे.
Naagzilla: कार्तिक आर्यन के पास प्रोजेक्ट्स की फिलहाल कोई कमी नहीं है. अभी कई बड़ी फिल्में उनके नाम हैं, जिस पर एक्टर लगातार काम कर रहे हैं. वहीं, ‘नागजिला’ भी उनमें से एक है, जिसे लेकर अब एक बेहद दिलचस्प और बड़ा अपडेट सामने आया है. इस फैंटेसी-कॉमेडी फिल्म में अब एक्टर रवि किशन की एंट्री हो गई है. जो पर्दे पर कार्तिक आर्यन के साथ दो-दो हाथ करते नजर आएंगे.
दरअसल फिल्म ‘नागजिला’ में रवि किशन विलेन ‘पाइथन’ का किरदार निभाने जा रहे हैं. फिल्म में कार्तिक आर्यन एक इच्छाधारी नाग ‘प्रियंवदेश्वर प्यारे चंद’ का रोल कर रहे हैं. ऐसे में एक इच्छाधारी नाग और पाइथन के बीच होने वाली यह टक्कर लोगों के लिए काफी मजेदार होने वाली है. अपनी दमदार आवाज, खास अंदाज और बेहतरीन कॉमिक टाइमिंग के लिए रवि किशन पॉपुलर हैं. अब उनके जुड़ने से फिल्म की स्टारकास्ट और भी मजबूत हो गई है.
कार्तिक की ‘नागजिला’ में रवि किशन की एंट्री
‘नागजिला’ का डायरेक्शन ‘फुकरे’ जैसी सुपरहिट फ्रेंचाइजी बनाने वाले डायरेक्टर मृगदीप सिंह लांबा कर रहे हैं. जबकि इसकी कहानी गौतम मेहरा ने लिखी है. फिल्म को करण जौहर के धर्मा प्रोडक्शंस और महावीर जैन फिल्म्स के बैनर तले बनाया जा रहा है. लोककथाओं, फैंटेसी और कॉमेडी के अनोखे मेल वाली यह फिल्म जल्द रिलीज होगी. जो कार्तिक आर्यन के करियर के सबसे अलग प्रोजेक्ट्स में से एक है. जिसमें भरपूर मनोरंजन और विजुअल इफेक्ट्स देखने को मिलेंगे. दरअसल इस प्रोजेक्ट में एक्ट्रेस प्रीति मुकुंदन भी एक अहम किरदार में दिखाई देंगी.
फिल्म की रिलीज डेट को लेकर भी ताजा जानकारी सामने आई है. पहले इस फिल्म को साल 2026 में रिलीज करने की प्लानिंग थी. लेकिन अब मेकर्स ने इसे आगे बढ़ाते हुए वैलेंटाइन वीकेंड का खास स्लॉट चुना है. ‘नागजिला’ अब 12 फरवरी 2027 को सिनेमाघरों में दस्तक देगी. बड़े पर्दे पर पहली बार कार्तिक आर्यन और रवि किशन की यह जुगलबंदी और टक्कर देखने को मिलेगी. जिसे देखने के लिए फैन्स अभी से काफी एक्साइटेड हैं.

title: Bangladesh Crisis: बांग्लादेश में फिर बवाल… शेख हसीना की वापसी से यूनुस की बढ़ी टेंशन
description: बांग्लादेश में अवामी लीग के लॉकडाउन के आह्वान के बाद हिंसा और आगजनी हुई. शेख हसीना की दिसंबर में वापसी की घोषणा के बीच तारिक रहमान सरकार की मुश्किलें बढ़ती दिख रही हैं.
author: चेतना प्रकाश
content:
Bangladesh Crisis: बांग्लादेश में फिर बवाल… शेख हसीना की वापसी से यूनुस की बढ़ी टेंशन
बांग्लादेश में अवामी लीग के लॉकडाउन के आह्वान के बाद हिंसा और आगजनी हुई. शेख हसीना की दिसंबर में वापसी की घोषणा के बीच तारिक रहमान सरकार की मुश्किलें बढ़ती दिख रही हैं.
बांग्लादेश में पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री शेख हसीना की वापसी की घोषणा के बीच राजनीतिक तनाव बढ़ गया है. प्रतिबंधित अवामी लीग के लॉकडाउन के आह्वान के बाद देश के कई इलाकों में हिंसा, आगजनी और बम धमाकों की खबरें सामने आईं. पूर्व अंतरिम सरकार प्रमुख मोहम्मद यूनुस के पैतृक घर और ग्रामीण बैंक की कुछ शाखाओं को भी निशाना बनाया गया. रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, हिंसा में चार लोगों की मौत हुई. इस बीच प्रधानमंत्री तारिक रहमान ने लोकतांत्रिक ताकतों से एकजुट होने की अपील की है. दिसंबर में शेख हसीना की संभावित वापसी को लेकर बांग्लादेश की राजनीति में हलचल तेज है.

title: नाराज तो नहीं हो आप… झगड़ा करने वाले ने मांगी माफी, वैभव सूर्यवंशी के लिए अभिषेक शर्मा के दिल...
description: वैभव सूर्यवंशी ने एशिया कप राइजिंग स्टार्स में UAE के खिलाफ मुकाबले में दोहा के मैदान पर जो किया, उसके बाद अभिषेक शर्मा के दिल में उनके लिए इज्जत और बढ़ गई है.
author: साकेत शर्मा
content:
नाराज तो नहीं हो आप… झगड़ा करने वाले ने मांगी माफी, वैभव सूर्यवंशी के लिए अभिषेक शर्मा के दिल में बढ़ी इज्जत
वैभव सूर्यवंशी ने एशिया कप राइजिंग स्टार्स में UAE के खिलाफ मुकाबले में दोहा के मैदान पर जो किया, उसके बाद अभिषेक शर्मा के दिल में उनके लिए इज्जत और बढ़ गई है.
वैभव सूर्यवंशी के लिए अभिषेक शर्मा उनके बड़े भाई जैसे हैं. अब छोटे भाई के सामने बड़े भइया को कोई कुछ बोलेगा तो गुस्सा तो आएगा ही. UAE के गेंदबाज इबरार अहमद ने ऐसी ही हिमाकत की थी, जब वो अभिषेक शर्मा को आउट करने के बाद उनसे उलझ पड़े थे. मगर पाकिस्तानी मूल के UAE बॉलर इबरार को क्या पता था, उन्होंने किसके सामने और किससे वो झगड़ा किया था. नतीजा, उन्होंने उसका मोल अच्छे से चुकाया. वैभव ने अपने बल्ले को जोर पर इबरार अहमद की हालत ऐसी कर दी कि उन्हें मैच के बाद अभिषेक शर्मा से माफी मांगने को मजबूर होना पड़ा.
अभिषेक शर्मा से झगड़ने वाले ने मांगी माफी
वैभव सूर्यवंशी ने एशिया कप राइजिंग स्टार्स में UAE के खिलाफ 53 गेंदों पर 384.90 की स्ट्राइक रेट से 204 रन बनाए, जिसमें 28 छक्के और 7 चौके शामिल रहे. UAE ने वैभव के खिलाफ 5 गेंदबाज आजमाए और पांचों में कोई ऐसा नहीं रहा, जिसे अच्छे से वैभव ने पीटा नहीं. मगर जिसे सबसे ज्यादा बुरी तरह से मारा, वो रहे अभिषेक शर्मा से लड़ने वाले इबरार अहमद. इबरार ने इंडिया ए के खिलाफ 3 ओवर में 71 रन लुटाए. मतलब इकॉनमी 23.66 की रही. इतनी मार खाने के बाद शायद ये इबरार अहमद के होश ही ठिकाने आए थे, जो वो मैच खत्म होते ही सीधे अभिषेक के पास माफी मांगने आ गए.
इबरार ने शेयर किया माफीनामे का वीडियो
इबरार अहमद ने 24 नवंबर को खेले मुकाबले के बाद एक वीडियो शेयर किया, जिसमें वो अभिषेक शर्मा से माफी मांगते दिख रहे हैं. इबरार ने अभिषेक से पूछा कि भी कि कहीं आप नाराज तो नहीं. अभिषेक ने नाराजगी की बात को नकारते हुए इबरार को माफ कर दिया.
वैभव के लिए अभिषेक के दिल में बढ़ी इज्जत
अभिषेक शर्मा ने अपने से झगड़ने वाले गेंदबाज को तो माफ कर दिया, मगर उसके बाद उनके दिल में वैभव सूर्यवंशी के लिए इज्जत बढ़ी दिखी. उन्होंने अपनी इंस्टा स्टोरी में UAE के खिलाफ खेली वैभव के तूफानी दोहरे शतक वाली पारी की फोटो पोस्ट की और लिखा- स्पेशल. मतलब जो भी रहा, वो खास रहा.

content:
दिल्ली: प्रीत विहार का सल्तनत कैफे, जहां दोस्त ही बन गए हैवान… 22 साल की युवती से गैंगरेप, 4 घंटे की नाइट पार्टी में क्या-क्या हुआ?
Preet Vihar gangrape case: पुलिस के मुताबिक, कैफे रात 11:30 बजे बंद हो गया था, लेकिन ग्रुप में शामिल एक शख्स के पास उसकी चाबी मौजूद थी. इसी के जरिए कैफे को दोबारा खोला गया.
Delhi gangrape case: दिल्ली के प्रीत विहार में सल्तनत कैफे है. यहां 22 साल की युवती के साथ गैंगरेप की घटना ने हिलाकर रख दिया है. जिन दोस्तों के साथ युवती पार्टी करने पहुंची थी, उन्होंने ही उसके साथ दरिंदगी की. पीड़िता का आरोप है कि उसके दो सहकर्मियों ने उसके साथ गैंगरेप किया, जबकि वहां मौजूद अन्य लोगों ने उनका साथ दिया. इस मामले में पुलिस ने दो महिलाओं समेत तीन आरोपियों को गिरफ्तार किया है. वहीं, तीन अन्य आरोपी अभी फरार हैं.
पीड़िता कड़कड़डूमा स्थित क्रॉस रिवर मॉल के एक कैफे में काम करती है. आरोपी भी उसी कैफे में उसके साथ काम करते थे. सभी एक-दूसरे को पहले से जानते थे. सोमवार की रात युवती अपने छह सहकर्मियों के साथ पार्टी करने के लिए प्रीत विहार स्थित सल्तनत कैफे पहुंची थी. इस ग्रुप में पुरुषों के साथ महिलाएं भी शामिल थीं.
बताया जा रहा है कि सभी लोग रात में पार्टी करने के इरादे से कैफे पहुंचे थे. उस समय कैफे बंद होने का समय हो चुका था. रात करीब 11:30 बजे कैफे बंद हो गया था, लेकिन ग्रुप में शामिल एक शख्स के पास परिसर की चाबी थी. इसी चाबी से कैफे को दोबारा खोला गया और फिर अंदर पार्टी शुरू हुई.
रात 11:30 बजे से सुबह 3:30 बजे तक चली पार्टी
पुलिस सूत्रों के मुताबिक, कैफे दोबारा खुलने के बाद सभी लोगों ने वहां शराब पी. पार्टी कई घंटे तक चली. रात का सन्नाटा था और कैफे के अंदर युवती अपने परिचित सहकर्मियों के साथ मौजूद थी. करीब सुबह 3:30 बजे सभी लोग कैफे से बाहर निकले.
इस तरह करीब चार घंटे तक पार्टी चलने के बाद ग्रुप वहां से निकला. 22 वर्षीय लड़की ने आरोप लगाया कि उसके साथ दो युवकों ने गैंगरेप किया है. पीड़िता का कहना है कि इस दौरान वहां मौजूद अन्य सहकर्मियों ने भी आरोपियों का साथ दिया.
दो महिलाओं समेत तीन गिरफ्तार, तीन की तलाश
घटना की शिकायत मिलने के बाद पुलिस ने मामला दर्ज कर जांच शुरू की. पुलिस ने गैंगरेप से संबंधित धाराओं में केस दर्ज किया है. इस मामले में अब तक तीन लोगों को गिरफ्तार किया गया है, जिनमें दो महिलाएं और एक पुरुष शामिल हैं. वहीं, तीन अन्य आरोपी अभी फरार हैं. पुलिस उनकी तलाश में जुटी है.
जांच में पुलिस पार्टी में शामिल सभी लोगों की भूमिका का पता लगाने की कोशिश कर रही है. आरोपियों से पूछताछ के आधार पर घटना से जुड़े दूसरे पहलुओं की भी पड़ताल की जा रही है.
इस घटना ने कई सवाल खड़े कर दिए हैं. युवती जिन लोगों को अपना सहकर्मी और परिचित मानती थी, उन्हीं के साथ पार्टी करने पहुंची थी. लेकिन अब उन्हीं लोगों पर गंभीर आरोप लगे हैं.फिलहाल पुलिस फरार आरोपियों की तलाश कर रही है. जांच पूरी होने और सभी आरोपियों से पूछताछ के बाद ही स्पष्ट हो सकेगा कि उस रात कैफे के अंदर क्या-क्या हुआ था और किसकी क्या भूमिका थी. फिलहाल युवती के आरोपों की जांच जारी है.

title: Missed Flight After 4-Hour Train Delay, Jammu Couple Gets Rs 63,000 From Indian Railways
description: A consumer commission in Jammu has ordered Northern Railways to pay Rs 63,199 to a couple who missed their Guwahati flight after the Delhi Duronto Express arrived nearly four hours late in Delhi, rejecting the Railways' defence that fog caused the delay.
author: Pradeep Dutta, Nikhil Pandey
content:
What was meant to be a routine journey from Jammu to Delhi, followed by a flight to Guwahati, ended with a missed flight, an unplanned hotel stay and additional travel expenses for a couple whose train arrived nearly four hours late.
The Jammu District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission has directed Northern Railways to pay Rs 63,199 in compensation to Mohit Singh Bhau and his wife, Damini Billoria, who missed their connecting flight after their train was delayed.
The order, passed on November 4 by Commission President Pawan Dev Kotwal and Member Neelam Bala Bhardwaj, held the Railways guilty of deficiency in service.
According to the complaint, the couple boarded the Delhi Duronto Express from Jammu on December 19, 2022. The train was scheduled to arrive in Delhi at 3:55 am the following day but reached at 7:50 am, nearly four hours behind schedule.
Their flight to Guwahati was scheduled to depart at 7:15 am. By the time the train arrived, the flight had already departed.
The couple told the Commission that they had to spend Rs 35,699 on fresh flight tickets and Rs 2,500 on a hotel stay in Delhi. They claimed the expense of Rs 38,199 was caused by the train's delay.
They sought Rs 60,000 towards financial losses, Rs 50,000 for mental agony and inconvenience, and Rs 30,000 as litigation expenses.
In its defence, Northern Railways attributed the delay to fog and cited Rule 115 of the Indian Railway Conference Association Coaching Tariff to contest liability.
The Commission, however, observed that the Railways had neither filed a timely written response nor produced evidence to establish that the delay was beyond its control. It held that a claim of fog, without supporting evidence, was insufficient.
Holding the Railways liable, the Commission directed it to reimburse the couple Rs 38,199 spent on fresh flight tickets and hotel accommodation, along with annual interest at 7.5 per cent. It also awarded Rs 20,000 for mental agony and inconvenience and Rs 5,000 towards litigation costs, taking the total compensation to Rs 63,199.
The Commission directed that the amount be paid within six weeks of receipt of the order.

title: The Italy Trip Behind Sonia Gandhi's Memoir Cover Clicked By Rajiv Gandhi
description: Priyanka Gandhi said her mother Sonia Gandhi had found it much easier to write those early chapters about her Italian childhood, meeting Rajiv Gandhi and their marriage than the later political years
author: Debanish Achom
content:
Congress leader Sonia Gandhi has shared the story behind the cover photograph of her memoir, Belonging: A Journey of Love, recalling how a young Rajiv Gandhi clicked the portrait in Italy around the time her father initially turned down his marriage proposal.
In a video titled 'What Ma Left Out of Her Book' uploaded on YouTube, Sonia Gandhi sat down at a roundtable with her children, Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, for a light, candid discussion on the memories and episodes that did not make it into the memoir.
The siblings asked where the photo had been taken, pointing to the youthful portrait of their mother on the book jacket.
"I remember there was a long discussion about this picture, and there were a number of pictures that would be likely the cover. Why this one?" Rahul Gandhi said.
Gandhi said the portrait held deep personal significance because of who was behind the lens and the occasion on which it was taken. "Because this is the picture that papa took of me when he came to Turin and then to Orbassano to ask my father to tell him that he wanted to marry me," she said.
"And what did your father say?"
"No. Thank you, but no thank you," Sonia Gandhi said and burst out laughing alongside Priyanka Gandhi.
She said that while her father, Stefano Maino, saw Rajiv Gandhi's character clearly, he remained hesitant about sending her away into an unfamiliar world of Indian politicians.
"My father said, 'You look at the boy in the eyes and you know the man.' But it wasn't that easy," Sonia Gandhi said. "His reasons were that, 'Where is my daughter going? In a different world, and a world we don't know, politicians, rich people, no.' Because that is the idea of many people in Italy at that time about politicians, right? He thought I couldn't possibly belong to that world, and that's why he was a bit concerned."
Priyanka Gandhi said her mother had found it much easier to write those early chapters about her Italian childhood, meeting Rajiv Gandhi and their marriage than the later political years.
After coming to India in 1968, less than two decades after Independence, Sonia Gandhi said she was initially shocked by the widespread poverty which she recalled was grim even in Delhi.
The family chat frequently turned to what the siblings called their mother's "selective memory" and an old habit, passed down from her Italian father, of never praising her children to their faces.
Even when the siblings complimented how beautiful she looked in her old photographs, Sonia Gandhi brushed it aside, explaining that her father always used to put them down at home while praising them only when guests visited.
"One day I asked her, 'Am I good-looking?' She said, 'No, you're average,'" Rahul Gandhi said.
Sonia Gandhi also brushed aside the decades of political attacks and thanked the common people for embracing her from the time she arrived as a young bride.
"Many said horrible things, but the bulk of the people, most people, accepted me and they welcomed me as one of their own, as a daughter. I love India because of that," she said.
The memoir, published by HarperCollins India, comes more than a decade after Sonia Gandhi first told NDTV in July 2014 that she intended to write her own book to bring out the "real truth" following claims made by former union minister K Natwar Singh about her decision to decline the prime ministership in 2004.

title: Rural Areas Cleaner Than Cities? What IIT Delhi Study Has Revealed
description: The sources of pollution identified by the study include vehicular traffic, construction, and commercial sources. It also said that stubble burning contributes to seasonal deterioration in the air quality in Delhi and areas around it.
author: Amit Chaturvedi
content:
It is widely believed that villages are cleaner than cities. The factors often cited are lower population density, less industrial activity and more open spaces. But a study led by IIT-Delhi and University of California, Berkley, has broken the popular notion, noting that levels of fine particulate pollution at rural sites routinely exceeds those at urban sites by about 20 per cent. The study, published in the journal PNAS, studied a network of 49 monitoring sites in rural areas around national capital Delhi.
The study is based on data from July 2024 to November 2024. It found that PM2.5, the fine particulate matter that is 30 times smaller than the width of an average human air, was higher in rural sites than those at urban centres during every month.
"Our findings run contrary to the general societal perception that Indian cities are pollution hotspots relative to rural areas," the research team wrote in PNAS.
The 49 monitoring sites tracked air pollution data along a 160-km transect in villages and small urban areas around Delhi and compared it with the pollution levels in the national capital.
Researchers found that smog concentrations increased sharply around mid-October and November.
In these five months, the average morning PM2.5 level in rural areas was 301 mg per cubic metres as against 252 mg per cubic metres at urban sites, the study showed. In the evening, villages recorded 263 mg per cubic metres of PM2.5 as against 210 mg per cubic metres in the city area.
The sources of pollution identified by the study include vehicular traffic, construction, and commercial sources. It also said that stubble burning contributes to seasonal deterioration in the air quality in Delhi and areas around it.
It, however, doesn't explain the unusually high pollution levels in the rural areas, said the study.
The pollution in rural areas recorded sharp increase between 5 am and 8 am and again between 5 pm and 8 pm. Pollution levels remain similar around midday in both rural and urban areas when atmospheric dilution was strongest.
The rise in rural pollution was due to local combustion activities, including biomass burning for cooking. Local industries like brick kilns also contribute to the pollution - an example is Loni, which is situated just 30 km from Delhi.

title: Kerala Officials Begin Search For Wild Tusker, Deploy 2 Elephants
description: The Forest Department plans to tranquilise Chakkakomban and fit it with a satellite radio collar, but residents insist that relocating the elephant is the only effective solution to their problems.
author: Aswin Nandakumar
content:
The Kerala Forest Department's mission to tranquilise and radio-collar Chakkakomban, a wild elephant that has been triggering concerns among residents of Chinnakanal and neighbouring areas in Idukki district, has been temporarily halted after the elephant moved away from the tracking team.
Chief Conservator of Forests (CCF) DK Vinod Kumar said the operation would resume at noon. The elephant had moved towards the 80-acre island near the Anayirangal dam, making it difficult for officials to safely administer a tranquiliser dart.
Officials are waiting for the elephant to move to suitable terrain before proceeding with the operation. Tranquilising the elephant near the reservoir could endanger its life if it enters the water after being darted.
According to Kumar, Chakkakomban usually goes to sleep by 8 am and wakes up around 2 or 3 pm. Since the elephant had covered a considerable distance the previous day, officials decided against disturbing it during its resting hours.
The operation began early this morning, with 140 Forest Department personnel splitting into multiple teams to track the elephant, which was initially spotted in the 301 Colony area of Chinnakanal.
Two trained kumki elephants, Vikram and Bharat, brought from Muthanga in Wayanad, were also deployed as part of the mission.
STORY | Two kumki elephants deployed to radio-collar wild tusker in Idukki Two trained kumki elephants were brought to Chinnakanal here on Monday as part of efforts to tranquilise and radio-collar wild elephant Chakkakomban, which has allegedly become a threat to human lives in the area, forest officials said. READ: https://t.co/RkAU67veZo VIDEO | (Full video available on PTI Videos - https://t.co/bIyFWTfmBd)
— Press Trust of India (@PTI_News) November 23, 2026
The Forest Department had conducted a mock drill on Tuesday ahead of the operation, which was scheduled to begin at 6 am on Wednesday. Officials had initially hoped to complete the mission within five hours.
Drones and ground surveillance teams have been deployed to monitor the elephant's movements. Prohibitory orders have also been imposed in the area, restricting public movement to ensure the safety of residents and personnel involved in the operation.
Chakkakomban derives its name from two Malayalam words: 'Chakka', meaning jackfruit, and 'Komban', meaning a tusker.
The elephant earned its name because of its fondness for jackfruit. According to residents, it frequently ventured into human settlements in search of jackfruit and agricultural produce.
Over the years, however, its presence in inhabited areas has become a growing concern. Residents of Chinnakanal, Santhanpara and neighbouring areas have complained of crop damage and threats to their safety due to the elephant's frequent movements near houses and agricultural land.
While the Forest Department intends to fit Chakkakomban with a satellite radio collar and release it back into the Chinnakanal landscape, local residents are demanding its relocation.
The radio collar will enable officials to monitor the elephant's movements and issue advance warnings whenever it approaches human settlements.
Residents, however, argue that tracking the elephant will not eliminate the threat it poses to their lives and livelihoods. They are demanding that Chakkakomban be relocated to another forest, as was done in the case of Arikomban, another wild tusker from the region.
The Forest Department's immediate plan is to radio-collar the elephant and monitor its subsequent movements. Relocation could be considered if the elephant continues to pose a threat to residents.
The operation has once again brought into focus the growing human-elephant conflict in Kerala's high ranges and the challenge of balancing wildlife conservation with the safety of people living along forest fringes.
For now, the Forest Department is waiting for Chakkakomban to move to a safe location where the operation can be carried out safely without risk of drowning in the dam.

title: UGC-NET December 2026 City Slip Releasing Today, Here's Direct Link To Download
description: UGC-NET December 2026: The examination will be conducted in Computer-Based Test (CBT) mode from December 14 to 18 and on December 21, 2026.
author: Rahul Kumar
content:
UGC-NET December 2026: The National Testing Agency (NTA) is expected to release the city intimation slips for the University Grants Commission-National Eligibility Test (UGC-NET) December 2026 today. Once released, candidates will be able to access their city slips from the official website, ugcnet.nta.nic.in.
The NTA will conduct the UGC-NET December 2026 examination in Computer-Based Test (CBT) mode from December 14 to 18 and on December 21, 2026. The examination will be conducted in two shifts, from 9am to 12pm and 3pm to 6pm.
The examination will be of 180 minutes (three hours), with no break between Paper 1 and Paper 2.
UGC-NET is conducted to assess the eligibility of Indian nationals for the award of Junior Research Fellowship and appointment as Assistant Professor; appointment as Assistant Professor and admission to PhD; and admission to PhD only in Indian universities and colleges.
Pattern Of Examination
The test paper will comprise two sections, both consisting of objective-type, multiple-choice questions. The medium of the question paper will be English and Hindi only, except for language papers.
Marking Scheme
1. Candidates must choose one option as the correct answer.
2. Each question carries two marks.
3. Candidates will be awarded two marks for each correct response.
4. There will be no negative marking for incorrect responses.
5. Questions answered or attempted will be evaluated irrespective of whether they are marked for review. Questions that are unanswered or unattempted will not be evaluated, irrespective of whether they are marked for review.
The information bulletin states that while every effort will be made to ensure that each question has only one unique answer, if a question is found to have more than one correct option, it will be dealt with in the following manner:
a) If more than one option is found to be correct, two marks (+2) will be awarded only to candidates who have marked any of the correct options.
b) If all options are found to be correct, two marks (+2) will be awarded to all candidates who have attempted the question.
c) If none of the options is found to be correct, or a question is found to be wrong or dropped, two marks (+2) will be awarded only to candidates who have attempted the question. This could be due to a human or technical error.
Since there is no negative marking, candidates should choose the most appropriate option as the correct answer.

title: Delhi Wakes Up To Coldest Morning Of Season At 10 Degrees Celsius
description: Air quality in Delhi remained in the poor category, with four monitoring stations recording 'very poor' readings.
author: Press Trust Of India
content:
Delhi recorded its coldest morning of the season on Wednesday, with the minimum temperature settling at 10 degrees Celsius.
The minimum temperature at Safdarjung, the city's base weather station, was 1.3 degrees below the season's normal, while it dropped by 1.2 degrees compared to the previous day.
Air quality in Delhi remained in the poor category, with four monitoring stations recording 'very poor' readings, even as the city's average Air Quality Index (AQI) stood at 224.
The total number of weather stations active at 9.05 am was 56 out of the total 59 in the city.
Other parts of the city also recorded relatively low temperatures. Lodhi Road recorded a minimum of 10.1 degrees Celsius, followed by Ayanagar at 10.4 degrees, Palam at 11 degrees and the Ridge at 11.7 degrees.
The minimum temperature at Palam remained unchanged from Tuesday, while Lodhi Road recorded a drop of 0.6 degrees. The Ridge saw a fall of 0.3 degrees, while Ayanagar recorded a marginal rise of 0.2 degrees.
No rainfall was recorded at any of the five weather stations during the 24 hours ending at 8.30 am on Wednesday.
According to the CPCB, an AQI between 0 and 50 is classified as 'good', 51 and 100 as 'satisfactory', 101 and 200 as 'moderate', 201 and 300 as 'poor', 301 and 400 as 'very poor', and 401 and 500 as 'severe'.
The Indian Meteorological Department (IMD) has forecasted shallow fog for the day, and the maximum temperature is likely to touch 25 degrees Celsius.

title: "Child To Me": Ramdev On "Scolding" Religious Leader Dhirendra Shastri On Lord Krishna Remark
description: In Pathankot, Dhirendra Shastri responded during a katha, saying he accepts both praise and criticism from Baba Ramdev.
author: Indo Asian News Service
content:
Yoga guru Baba Ramdev on Tuesday clarified his recent critical remarks against Bageshwar Dham's Dhirendra Shastri, saying the young spiritual leader is "like a child", "younger brother" and "disciple" to him. Speaking at a press conference in Haridwar, Ramdev said he had scolded Shastri out of affection after feeling hurt by certain comments.
"Bageshwar Baba is like a child in front of me. He is also like my younger brother and disciple. Therefore, the things that seemed inappropriate to me and caused me pain, I reprimanded him with my authority. He too accepted my scolding as love. This is also his greatness," Ramdev stated.
He revealed that he had spoken to Dhirendra Shastri a day earlier. Ramdev said he was deeply pained by comments being made about deities.
"This is not the Sanatan tradition. There is no discrimination among deities. Discrimination being done in the name of deities, castes and religions is dividing society. I was very sad," he said.
READ | Case Against Religious Leader Dhirendra Shastri Over Lord Krishna Comments
Ramdev stressed that Sanatan Dharma should not be linked with superstition or hypocrisy.
"Sanatan Dharma is divine. Sanatan Dharma is scientific. The values of Sanatan Dharma are very high," he added, noting that the matter had been wrongly trolled and his words misinterpreted.
Meanwhile, in Pathankot, Dhirendra Shastri responded during a katha, saying he accepts both praise and criticism from Baba Ramdev.
"Ramdev ji is very simple. He is a great man. He is our own. There is great joy between both of us. If something was in his mind, he gave a blessing. This too is a blessing. A good blessing," Shastri said.
He recalled that Ramdev had praised him highly four days earlier and then criticised him four days later.
"I am happy with both. He is a revered swami. He is a guru. He can say whatever he wants with love," Shastri added.
He emphasised that he would not react to Ramdev's words, describing him as senior and a guardian figure who has always shown affection.
"We accept his criticism as well as his praise. We cannot have any feeling of disregard towards saints. We aim to unite Hindu society, not to divide it."
The controversy began after Baba Ramdev's strong remarks against certain kathavachaks. He had criticised those who claim to be Sanatanis without knowledge of the Vedas, Upanishads, Puranas, Ramayana, Mahabharata or the Constitution, calling some of them hypocrites who create religious frenzy and exploit people, especially women, in the name of ghosts and obstacles.
Particularly, Baba Ramdev had objected to comments comparing Lord Ram and Lord Krishna, and to light-hearted remarks about deities.
He had said that one should not compare or disrespect divine powers even in jest, and that he spoke from the stage so that no one could later say that hypocrisy continued unchecked in his presence.
On 17 November, both had shared the stage in Pratapgarh during a katha organised at the residence of MLA Raja Bhaiya, where they exchanged garlands.

title: FSSAI Scrutiny Limited To One Goa Batch, Now Out Of Circulation: Bisleri
description: The company said its Goa facility had not received any direction to suspend operations and that samples from subsequent production had met applicable food safety standards.
author: Press Trust Of India
content:
Packaged drinking water maker Bisleri International on Tuesday said the FSSAI scrutiny related to just one batch manufactured at its Goa plant in September 2025, which is no longer in circulation, adding that subsequent testing found bromate levels in the sample within permissible limits.
The company said all its 143 manufacturing plants remain operational and compliant with FSSAI regulations, with the Goa facility also continuing operations without any suspension order from the regulator.
"Bisleri produces more than 50,000 batches annually. FSSAI's sale prohibition applies only to one Batch GO 270, manufactured in Goa on 27 September 2025. There are no stocks of this batch in the market currently," it said. "The FSSAI has categorically and conclusively clarified on 23rd November 2026 that bromates were found below the permissible limit on re-testing of the above batch sample."
Responding to an FSSAI clarification issued on November 23, Bisleri said the regulatory action related exclusively to batch GO 270, manufactured on September 27, 2025, and that no stocks from the batch were currently available in the market.
The company said FSSAI had clarified that bromate levels detected on retesting the batch sample were below the permissible limit. Separately, it acknowledged that one of six samples tested in a subsequent round had reported polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) at 0.144 micrograms per litre. Another sample from the same batch had cleared all parameters.
On Sunday, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) had said it had sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International, whose one sample of packaged drinking water failed in lab tests following the detection of bromate beyond permissible limits and, on subsequent testing, polynuclear aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs).
Bisleri had questioned the laboratory findings, citing discrepancies between test results, and said it has not received any formal notice of the reported regulatory action.
On Monday, FSSAI clarified that, as per the law, the report of the referral lab should be final in case of appeal by food business operators (FBOs). "The order for prohibition of sale was issued to Bisleri International for the Batch No. Go 270. Only one batch was found to be non-compliant. FBO (Bisleri) has been conveyed to conduct root cause analysis."
Bisleri on Tuesday said it had flagged discrepancies in the PAH findings and sought a retest in February 2026. It added that no subsequent samples tested by FSSAI across its plants had reported adverse PAH findings.
The company said samples from subsequent production at the Goa facility had met applicable FSSAI standards and that it would continue to cooperate with the regulator in the matter.
In a statement responding to an FSSAI clarification issued on November 23, the company said the regulatory action related to a single batch, identified as GO 270 and manufactured on September 27, 2025. It said no stock from the batch was currently available in the market.
Bisleri said FSSAI's retesting had established that bromate levels in the sample were below the permissible limit. However, the company acknowledged that one of six samples tested had reported the presence of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) at 0.144 micrograms per litre.
According to Bisleri, all six samples initially cleared testing, while a subsequent round of testing found PAHs in one sample from batch GO 270. Another sample from the same batch cleared all parameters.
The company said it had highlighted discrepancies in the findings and requested a retest of the PAH results in February 2026. It added that it would continue to cooperate with the food safety regulator and defend its position in any proceedings.
Bisleri also said no subsequent samples tested by FSSAI across its manufacturing facilities had reported adverse PAH findings.
Seeking to distinguish the regulatory scrutiny of the specific batch from its wider operations, Bisleri said all its 143 manufacturing plants remained operational and compliant with FSSAI regulations.
The company said its Goa facility had not received any direction to suspend operations and that samples from subsequent production had met applicable food safety standards.
Bisleri said it produces more than 50,000 batches annually, arguing that the regulatory action was confined to one batch manufactured more than a year ago.
The development comes amid heightened consumer sensitivity to packaged drinking water quality and regulatory oversight of food and beverage products. The distinction between findings in individual samples and compliance across subsequent production batches is likely to be important for consumer confidence and the company's brand reputation.
Bisleri said it welcomed the regulator's clarification and urged consumers to rely on verified information, adding that it would consider legal action against what it described as false and misleading claims.
Founded more than five decades ago, Bisleri International operates 143 plants and has a distribution network of more than 6,000 distributors and 7,500 distribution trucks across India and the UAE, according to the company.

title: Focus On Disgruntled Leaders As BJP Preps For UP Assembly Polls
description: As part of this initiative, dialogues will be held with senior leaders and party workers at the local unit, block, and assembly-constituency levels.
author: Ajay Kumar Dubey, Anindita Sanyal
content:
BJP's mega-plan to reconcile with disgruntled party members; responsibility entrusted to 35 senior leaders. Thirty-five senior party leaders have been tasked with this mission. They have been and assigned responsibilities on an assembly-constituency basis, with some overseeing 10 constituencies and others up to 15.
As part of this initiative, dialogues will be held with senior leaders and party workers at the local unit, block, and assembly-constituency levels.
Leaders from each tier will be invited for discussions, with approximately two hours dedicated to listening to their concerns.
Their grievances, challenges, and complaints regarding the organisation will also be documented.
A report detailing the issues raised and the concerns expressed by the party workers during these meetings will be submitted to the state-level party in-charge. Additionally, suggestions for resolving these issues will also be provided.
The objective behind this BJP initiative is to address internal discontent, re-engage veteran or estranged leaders, and unite all party workers as the organisation prepares for the upcoming electoral battle.
The decision is the upshot of a lesson from the 2022 assembly elections and 2024 Lok Sabha Polls, where the party had lost seats. Some of it had been attributed to disgruntled leaders.
This time, the BJP is not leaving anything to chance.
The idea of having senior leaders visit ground-level workers and getting their feedback was sparked at the party's recent two-day chintan baithak held in Mathura. It was attended by about 50 BJP leaders, including party chief Nitin Nabin and national general secretary (organisation) B L Santhosh.
Last month, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath had reached out to the disgruntled leaders and met them to give them a hearing. The focus came after one of the BJP's prominent backward community leaders from Rohilkhand, Dharmendra Kashyap, quit and joined the Samajwadi Party.
The BJP is now wary of losing other influential leaders ahead of next year's assembly elections.

title: Gadi Eisenkot Clinches 1st Coalition Partner In Race To Become Israel's PM
description: Eisenkot's centre-right Yashar party and patchwork coalition partners hold just 48 seats. But they have potential allies in the parties representing Israel's Arab minority, which hold 19 seats and are aligned with Eisenkot in their vehement opposition to Netanyahu.
author: Sanstuti Nath,  (with inputs from Reuters)
content:
Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party has signed a coalition pact with a right-wing opposition party in a bid to form the next government in Israel following October's elections. The Yashar party said its leader, Eisenkot, the former military chief, had met with Avigdor Lieberman, head of the Israel Our Home party, and both leaders agreed on a deal afterwards, the first such alliance since the election.
After no party managed to secure a 61-seat majority in the October 27 election, Israel's parliament was sworn in on November 10 without a new government, stripping Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of his majority but leaving others with no clear path to power.
President Isaac Herzog has tasked Eisenkot with forming a government, while Netanyahu remains caretaker prime minister.
After no party managed to secure a 61-seat majority, Israel's parliament was sworn in on November 10 without a new government.
Eisenkot has until December 6 to form a government under Israel's 28-day mandate. However, he could ask for a 14-day extension.
If he fails to form a government on time, Netanyahu would get a shot at it. If no one is able to reach a coalition, another election will be held next year.
The Coalition Race And Agendas
Netanyahu's right-wing Likud's alliance with far-right and ultra-Orthodox parties outperformed election expectations but still lost its majority. It now holds 53 of the Knesset's 120 seats.
Eisenkot's centre-right Yashar party and patchwork coalition partners -- including Lieberman -- hold just 48 seats. But they have potential allies in the parties representing Israel's Arab minority, which hold 19 seats and are aligned with Eisenkot in their vehement opposition to Netanyahu.
The agreement between Eisenkot, whose party won 21 parliament seats, and Lieberman, whose party won 7, was something of a surprise, since Lieberman had been vocal about his opposition to forming a government with support from Arab parties as well as to a unity government with Netanyahu.
Lieberman has also said his main goal is to oust Netanyahu from power.
Talks are also ongoing between Eisenkot, some of his "change bloc" partners and Likud on forming a unity government.
The left-wing Democrats party, which won 8 parliament seats, separately said it was suspending talks with Eisenkot because of progress in his talks with Netanyahu's Likud on a possible unity government and "given with the deadlock in negotiations to form a 'change government.'
Yair Golan, head of the Democrats, has said he prefers a government without Netanyahu but with Arab parties.

title: "Did You Check In The Toilet?" Man Gets Seat No. 54 Ticket, Finds Coach Has Only 52 Berths
description: A passenger named Ishan Bajpai has claimed that he was allotted berth A1/54 on Train No. 15132, despite the coach apparently having only 52 berths.
author: Nikhil Pandey
content:
A passenger's complaint about being unable to find his confirmed berth on an overnight train has sparked a debate on railway management and passenger services on social media. Ishan Bajpai shared his experience on X, saying he was travelling on Train No. 15132 when he discovered that his confirmed ticket showed berth A1/54, although the coach appeared to have only 52 berths.
The passenger said the incident took place at around 10.45 pm, making the situation particularly frustrating as he was travelling overnight.
"Being left without your confirmed seat at 10.45 PM, on an overnight journey, is extremely frustrating. Complaint raised on 139. How can this happen?" he wrote.
His post has received close to three lakh views, with several users questioning how a passenger could be allotted a berth number that apparently did not exist in the coach.

Railway Seva responds to passenger's complaint
The official Railway Seva account, which provides support to railway passengers on behalf of the Ministry of Railways, responded to Bajpai's post.
In its reply, the account said the matter had been escalated to the concerned official for necessary action.
"We regret the experience you had. Please share your mobile number, preferably via DM, to enable us to take immediate action. You may also raise your concern directly on railmadad.indianrailways.gov.in or dial 139 for speedy redressal," the response read.
Railway Seva also posted that the complaint had been escalated to the Divisional Railway Manager (DRM), Varanasi, for necessary action.
'Did you check in the toilet?' Internet reacts
The incident prompted a series of sarcastic and critical comments, with users questioning the apparent mismatch between the confirmed berth number and the number of berths in the coach.
"Did you check in the toilet or upstairs for a berth number? Railways seems to have over-delivered. More than 100 per cent berth numbers," one user joked.
Another user took a dig at the Railways' response, writing, "Sorry. The Railways regrets and deeply regrets and extremely deeply regrets the inconvenience. They are busy building bullet trains."
Some users also questioned the effectiveness of the railway grievance redressal system.
"Drag them to consumer court. If you can't do so, better close this matter. Railway Seva only asks for PNR number and mobile number in DM. Case closed after taking all credentials of passengers. Railway department is in complete chaos. You don't even get a ticket 60 days in advance," another user commented.
The incident has once again brought attention to passenger complaints about railway services and the importance of ensuring that confirmed ticket details match the actual seating arrangements on trains. title: Who Was Prabhjot Singh Mann? California Muay Thai Fighter, Bhangra Mentor Dies After Injury In Madrid
description: Prabhjot Singh Mann, a California-based Muay Thai fighter and bhangra mentor, dies after a head injury in a Madrid tournament.
author: Abhinav Singh
content:
A California-based Muay Thai fighter has passed away after suffering a severe head injury during a tournament in Madrid, Spain. The fighter, Prabhjot Singh Mann, sustained the devastating injury on November 7 and had to be airlifted to a local university hospital, where he remained in the intensive care unit (ICU) receiving critical care before passing away on Saturday (Nov 21).
Mann, who hailed from Fresno, California, was deeply involved in the Central Valley's Sikh community. He volunteered and mentored local youth and taught traditional Bhangra dance.
District 1 Fresno City Council Candidate Naindeep Singh took to social media to pay a deeply emotional tribute to Prabhjot, whom he met as a youngster.
"I first met you when you were 10 years old and you could not sit down. That boy became a young man others followed," said Singh. "In the ring, that motion found its form, and you became a Muay Thai champion. The fighter's discipline and the Sikh's were one: train unseen, take the blow, rise. You were taken from us too soon, but in the ring you loved," he added.
Who Was Prabhjot Singh Mann?
Prabhjot's family hailed from Pind Bugra, a small village in the Hoshiarpur district of Punjab. Prabhjot's brother, Sukhjot Mann, started a GoFundMe campaign to bring him back to the US to be close to home for recovery. However, due to the extremely costly airlifting procedure, the family relied on the kindness of strangers to bring Prabhjot home.
"This fundraiser will help cover medical air transportation from Madrid, Spain, to the United States. It will also help with medical bills from Madrid, future medical expenses in the US, and any necessary therapy to support his recovery. The financial burden of his care has been overwhelming for our family.
Before the fundraiser was paused, the family had managed to raise more than $440,000 (Rs 4.07 crore) with nearly 4,200 donors pooling in the money. Final rites will be performed on Monday (Nov 30) at the Shant Bhavan Funeral Home in Fowler, California.
The family said it will release the details regarding the livestream soon.

title: US To Detonate 68 Barrels Of Lead In Iowa A Day Before Thanksgiving
description: The controlled detonation of roughly 5 tons of the degraded lead azide inside 68 barrels at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown has set off concerns about potential health and environmental effects, and frustration over lack of information.
author: AP
content:
Iowa residents who could be in the path of a dangerous lead dust plume from the planned detonation of bomb-making chemicals sealed their windows and doors Tuesday and prepared to stay home from work.
Boxes of painter's tape and masks were scattered outside government buildings for those wanting to protect their homes and themselves. Shops and businesses planned to close after the US Army announced the detonation would occur Wednesday morning, the day before Thanksgiving.
Others seemed to shrug off concerns as government officials warned those closest to be ready to evacuate to avoid lead in the air, while also assuring residents that barriers around the blast zone should limit much of the plume.
"It concerns me, but not overly," said Chris Fullenkamp, 62, who has lived his whole life near the plant.
"There's a lot on edge, but I think they're just jumping to conclusions or they want to get worked up about something," added Fullenkamp, whose house in West Point is 15 miles (24 kilometers) from the detonation site but still in the plume's likely path.
After days of delays, the Army plans to detonate the nation's entire stockpile of lead azide around 9 am local time Wednesday, saying that waiting longer could cause the dangerously degrading chemicals to explode on their own at any time.
"Inaction is no longer an option," said Maj. Gen. Eric Shirley, the Army's leader of the operation.
The controlled detonation of roughly 5 tons of the degraded lead azide inside 68 barrels at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown has set off concerns about potential health and environmental effects, and frustration over lack of information.
"We don't believe that the public should be in a panic," said acting Secretary of the Army Adam Telle. "Our goal is to keep as much of it as we can here on our Iowa Army Ammunition plant to prevent it from traveling."
Officials overseeing the detonation say the wind on Wednesday is expected to blow southwest and away from nearby Burlington, a city of just under 25,000 people that sits along the Mississippi River.
The Army released new maps Tuesday showing the likely trajectory of the plume traveling southwest toward Missouri. Extensive modeling shows that most of the rising cloud is expected to consist of non-toxic substances, including nitrogen gas, water vapor, clean sand and soil, Army officials said. They added that a small fraction of the cloud will consist of fine lead oxide dust from the original compound.
The US Department of Agriculture projected that 350 farms could be impacted based on the expected path of the plume and said it would make sure that no heavy metals or lead enter the food chain. Farmers were encouraged to move their animals indoors and protect hay bales and water tanks.
An "imminent threat alert" sent to cellphones Tuesday morning said some people within 5 miles (8 kilometers) southwest of the ammunition plant may be evacuated. Others farther out were told to remain indoors with their windows closed. Some residents covered their air conditioners with tarps.
Randy Welding, the city administrator in West Point, said he plans on being the only person in City Hall to monitor developments.
"We just don't want people out," he said. "Other than that, we're just going to wait and see what happens."
He said most people aren't too worried, "but we've never been through it before."
Still, the detonation and warnings of possible lead pollution were testing the resolve of rural Iowans who often pride themselves on their independence and stoicism.
Brett Moravec, a truck driver who lives about a half-mile (800 meters) from the plant, said the timing could have been better given it's happening the day before Thanksgiving. But he said the stockpile needs to be dealt with now.
"Delaying is just going to endanger more people," he said. "The government knows what it's doing. I know a lot of people don't think so."
The Army rescheduled the detonation to Wednesday because of more favorable wind conditions and to allow more time for extra safety measures.
Experts have advised that the stockpile will become more volatile as temperatures cool in the coming days.
The detonation was initially planned for last Friday. The Army said they need to blow up the stockpile to prevent a possible chain-reaction explosion, which would be more dangerous.
The Army has set up additional "blast barriers" around the bunkers where the stockpile will be detonated and will use ballistic gels and foams to absorb the lead dust. It also plans to douse the materials with thousands of gallons of water.
"We've taken every viable solution and considered it," Telle said. "In every instance, the answer is controlled detonation is safest."
Lucy Giehl, who lives about 5 miles (8 kilometers) from the site, said Tuesday that she's worried about letting her dogs outside if "I have raining lead tomorrow on my property." Beyond that, she's concerned about the potential long-term effects on the environment.
"I don't know if we'll be able to swim in the pond or if our dogs can drink out of the pond," she said. "We have bald eagles that fly by out here. There's so much wildlife, and it's all in danger."
The Army got final approval to carry out the detonation in a ruling late Monday that said the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency adequately incorporated safeguards to minimize the dispersal of dust.
Environmental groups had sued to stop the detonation.
The judges said the Army evaluated "a full range" of alternatives, including using other chemicals to neutralize the lead azide and thermal treatment, but determined detonation was safest.
The Army changed the detonation date three times following an outpouring of public concern.
Officials said the greatest risk of lead exposure was to children and pregnant women.
A team from the University of Iowa was deploying air monitors, collecting soil samples and positioning to measure the extent of any contamination, said David Cwiertny, director of the Center for Health Effects of Environmental Contamination.
"The things we are hearing a lot about are playground equipment, furniture, high-touch areas," he said.
Iowa Republican Gov. Kim Reynolds said Tuesday that after speaking with military leaders she supports the planned detonation.
But U.S. Sen. Joni Ernst, a Republican, said Iowans "are right to be frustrated" that more information, such as the risk of lead contamination from the blast, wasn't shared earlier.
The Army told her the detonation will last "only seconds" and the dust will dissipate within an hour. Air, soil, surface water and lead residue were sampled before the detonation and will continue to be sampled after to measure changes and guide cleanup, she said.
Telle, the acting secretary, said the Army is reviewing all of its weapons storage facilities to ensure something like this never happens again.
What matters now, he added, is "getting this operation right."

title: Ukraine Continues To Hit Russian Oil Plants Despite Trump's Requests: Putin
description: Kyiv has said it would stop striking Russian energy targets only when Moscow did the same.
author: Reuters
content:
Ukraine has continued attacks on Russian oil refineries despite requests from US President Donald Trump to refrain, Russian leader Vladimir Putin said on Tuesday, pledging to retaliate.
Kyiv has said it would stop striking Russian energy targets only when Moscow did the same. Ukrainian strikes subsided after Trump's mid-October declaration of an energy ceasefire, but they have picked up since the end of last month.
"We see that the Kyiv regime continues to attack our refining facilities, despite the US president's appeal and direct request to refrain from such attacks. But the Kyiv authorities are ignoring this advice," Putin told a meeting of government officials and senior oil executives in the Kremlin.
"In this regard, I would like to stress that retaliatory measures on our part are inevitable," he said.
He also told the meeting that he wanted additional security measures for energy facilities.
Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha, writing on X, said Putin could end Kyiv's strikes on refineries by halting the 4-1/2-year-old war.
"If Putin doesn't like Ukraine's strikes on his oil refineries, he can order an end to the war. If he doesn't want his military vessels hit, he can order an end to the war," Sybiha wrote.
Putin, he said, was paying scant attention to mounting Russian battlefield losses "without coming any closer to the goals of his invasion. Clearly, he doesn't care about them. Stop complaining. End the war."
According to estimates from two industry sources, Ukrainian drone attacks have cut Russian oil refineries' combined crude processing volumes by 45% since late October.
Several Russian regions have introduced restrictions on retail sales of gasoline and diesel following renewed Ukrainian attacks on oil refineries, according to local media and authorities.
Putin said that while the domestic fuel market remained difficult, gasoline prices had stabilised after peaking in October.
Europe To Shun Russian LNG
The European Union has decided to stop buying Russian seaborne liquefied natural gas starting January 1, though Russian LNG supplies to Europe still reached around 13.7 million metric tons last year.
According to LSEG preliminary data, Russian LNG exports to Europe increased by around 6.3% year-on-year in the first 10 months of this year, totalling 11.8 million tons.
Putin said that Europe's efforts to curb Russian energy exports backfired, with Russia expanding its sales markets and increasingly using the Northern Sea Route across its Arctic shores.

title: Australia Apologises To LGBTQ Service Members For Discrimination In Military
description: Australia lifted a ban on lesbian, gay and bisexual people serving in the Australian Defence Force in 1992.Until then, consensual homosexual activity could be prosecuted under military law.
author: Reuters
content:
The Australian government issued a formal apology on Wednesday to current and former LGBTQ service members for harm caused by decades of discriminatory policies.
"You and your families offered this nation everything that service asks. In return our nation offered condemnation, derision, and suspicion," Defence Minister Richard Marles told service members in a speech to parliament
"This country did not keep faith with you. But today, it says sorry."
Australia lifted a ban on lesbian, gay and bisexual people serving in the Australian Defence Force in 1992. Until then, consensual homosexual activity could be prosecuted under military law.
It maintained its ban on transgender people until 2010.
Marles said the discriminatory policies resulted in "witch hunts" where service members were tracked, interrogated and forced to either resign or be discharged dishonourably.
"Members of the Australian Defence Force were subjected to appalling treatment based on their sexual orientation," he said.
"It is a shameful chapter in the history of the Australian Defence Force."
He continued: "We asked these Australians to defend a fair go. Then we refused them one. None of this made our nation safer."
Marles added that while the ban on lesbian, gay and bisexual people serving was lifted in 1992, "it was a long time before Defence's culture and attitudes caught up"
In September, parliament passed a law to have historical homosexual convictions extinguished from service records.

title: Saudi Coalition Says 'Struck Yemen Port City', Houthis Threaten Retaliation
description: The coalition, which support Yemen's internationally recognised government, renewed fighting in July against the Iran-backed fighters, who control swathes of the country, including Hodeida.
author: Agence France Presse
content:
The Saudi-led military coalition fighting the Houthis said on Wednesday it had struck Yemen's Hodeida after the Iran-backed group threatened to retaliate against the kingdom's Red Sea ports if the attack took place.
The coalition, which support Yemen's internationally recognised government, renewed fighting in July against the Iran-backed fighters, who control swathes of the country, including Hodeida.
"We targeted operational capabilities at the port of Hodeidah," the Saudi-led coalition posted on X.
Riyadh had instructed civilians in Hodeida to evacuate in a social media post early on Wednesday.
The Houthi's military spokesperson, Yahya Saree, had earlier threatened Saudi Arabia with retaliation in the event of an attack.
"The port of Jeddah, along with all other Saudi enemy ports along the Red Sea coast, will become targets for our forces should the enemy carry out its threats to bombard the port of Hodeidah," he posted on Telegram on Wednesday.
Houthi media outlet Almasirah reported an "attack on the port of Hodeida", without providing further details. No casualties or injuries have been reported.
Almasirah added that Saudi forces had also attacked the area's international airport.
Saree warned civilians near Saudi ports to "evacuate immediately and keep their distance" and called for "all shipping companies to remove their vessels from these ports at once".
The Saudi capital's tallest skyscraper was struck for a second time in days on Tuesday, wounding 11 people. The coalition called it a "terrorist attack" and blamed the strike on the Houthis.
The building had already been attacked last Thursday and is one of several high-profile targets hit since fighting with the Iran-backed group reignited in July.

title: UPI Payment Gone To The Wrong Account? Know How To Recover Your Money
description: The chances of recovering the money can depend on how soon you report the transaction and whether the receiving bank can help facilitate its return.
author: Prateek Shukla
content:
UPI has made sending money as easy as scanning a QR code or entering a mobile number. But this convenience also comes with a risk. One wrong digit in a UPI ID, or a hurried tap on the wrong recipient's name, can send your money into someone else's bank account.
And unlike a failed transaction, a successful payment sent to the wrong person cannot simply be cancelled.
So, what should you do if you accidentally transfer money to the wrong UPI ID? Is there a way to get it back? And whom should you approach if the recipient refuses to return it?
Also Read | Layoffs Are Rising In Tech, But These Skills Are Helping People Unlock Better Pay
The first thing is to act quickly. The chances of recovering the money can depend on how soon you report the transaction and whether the receiving bank can help facilitate its return.
Atish Shelar, Group CEO, MOS Utility Limited, told NDTV that users should immediately check the transaction status and raise a complaint through their payment application.
Here are the steps you should follow:-
1. Check Your UPI Transaction Status
Before raising a complaint, check whether the payment was successful, pending or failed. Open the transaction history on Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm or BHIM. Select the payment and check its current status.
If the transaction has failed or is pending but the money has been debited, it generally follows a reversal process. The amount should be credited back according to the applicable transaction timelines. However, if the payment has been successfully transferred to another person's UPI ID, the recovery process is different. You will need to approach your bank and seek assistance in getting the money returned.
2. Raise A Complaint Through Your UPI App
Do not wait to see whether the money comes back on its own. Open the payment application and select the incorrect transaction. Go to the Help or Support section and raise a complaint under the relevant category.
Explain that the money was transferred to the wrong recipient. Provide the transaction details and save the complaint reference number. You should also keep the Unique Transaction Reference (UTR) number handy. It will help the bank and payment service provider trace the transaction.
3. Contact Your Bank Immediately
The next step is to contact the bank account from which the money was debited. Inform the bank that you have accidentally transferred money to the wrong UPI ID. Share the following details:
- Date and time of the transaction
- Amount transferred
- UTR or transaction reference number
- Beneficiary's UPI ID
- Screenshot of the payment
- Complaint reference number generated by your UPI app
- Ask your bank to initiate a recovery request with the beneficiary's bank.
The receiving bank may contact its customer and facilitate the return of the money. However, a successful UPI payment cannot be reversed unilaterally. Recovery is not guaranteed and may require the recipient's consent.
4. Escalate The Complaint To NPCI
If your complaint is not resolved through the UPI application or your bank, you can escalate the matter through the payment service provider's grievance mechanism and NPCI's UPI dispute-redressal system. The usual escalation process moves from the UPI application to its payment service provider, the customer's bank and then NPCI.
You can visit NPCI's official website to access information on its UPI grievance-redressal mechanism. Keep all complaint numbers, bank correspondence and transaction records. These documents will be important if you need to escalate the matter further.
5. Approach The RBI Ombudsman
What if the bank does not respond or refuses to address your complaint?
You can approach the RBI Integrated Ombudsman after first complaining to the concerned regulated entity.
Under the Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2026, which came into effect on July 1, a customer can approach the Ombudsman if the bank has not responded within 30 days, or the applicable timeline prescribed under RBI, NPCI or card network guidelines, whichever is later.
You can also approach the Ombudsman if you are dissatisfied with the bank's response. Complaints can be filed through the RBI Complaint Management System.
However, remember that the Ombudsman mechanism addresses deficiencies in services provided by regulated entities. It does not automatically guarantee recovery of money transferred to an incorrect recipient.
6. What If It Was A UPI Fraud?
There is an important difference between accidentally sending money to the wrong person and being tricked into transferring money. If you suspect that the transaction was part of a cyber fraud, immediately call the national cybercrime helpline at 1930.
You should also register a complaint on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal. The faster you report the incident, the better the chances of authorities and banks being able to trace or restrict the movement of the money.
Section 72 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872, also deals with money paid or delivered by mistake or under coercion. It may provide a legal basis for seeking repayment if the recipient refuses to return money received by mistake. However, the circumstances of the transaction matter, and legal advice may be necessary.
What Do Experts Say?
Aqib Muhammed, Co-Founder & CEO, Synctric Technology, told NDTV that the first hour after an incorrect UPI transfer is particularly important.
"The first hour matters most. If you've paid the wrong person, raise a dispute inside your UPI app immediately using the transaction ID, and call your bank. A failed payment that's debited should auto-reverse, but a transfer to a valid wrong account can only be returned with the recipient's consent, so speed is your best lever," he said.
He also advised users to escalate unresolved complaints to NPCI and the RBI Ombudsman. For suspected fraud, he recommended calling 1930 immediately. He cautioned users against sharing their UPI PIN with anyone promising to process a refund. "A PIN only sends money, never receives it," he said.
Atish Shelar of MOS Utility Limited also stressed the importance of checking transaction details and following the formal grievance-redressal process rather than relying on informal assurances.
